<solution_file path="src/solution.py">
import csv
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd


def main():
    here = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    root = here.parent if here.name == "src" else here

    stops_path = root / "outputs" / "t05_clean_stops.csv"
    stop_times_path = root / "outputs" / "t05_clean_stop_times.csv"
    gtfs_zip_path = root / "inputs" / "gtfs" / "sample_city_gtfs.zip"
    out_path = root / "outputs" / "t06_stop_service_intensity.csv"

    out_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    stops = pd.read_csv(
        stops_path,
        dtype={
            "stop_id": "int64",
            "stop_name": "string",
            "stop_lat": "string",
            "stop_lon": "string",
        },
        keep_default_na=False,
    )

    stop_times = pd.read_csv(
        stop_times_path,
        dtype={
            "trip_id": "int64",
            "arrival_time": "string",
            "departure_time": "string",
            "stop_id": "int64",
            "stop_sequence": "int64",
        },
    )

    with zipfile.ZipFile(gtfs_zip_path) as zf:
        with zf.open("trips.txt") as f:
            trips = pd.read_csv(
                f,
                dtype={
                    "route_id": "int64",
                    "trip_id": "int64",
                },
            )

    departure_counts = stop_times.groupby("stop_id", sort=False).size()

    stop_routes = stop_times[["trip_id", "stop_id"]].merge(
        trips[["trip_id", "route_id"]],
        on="trip_id",
        how="left",
    )
    stop_routes = stop_routes.dropna(subset=["route_id"])
    route_counts = stop_routes.groupby("stop_id", sort=False)["route_id"].nunique()

    valid_times = stop_times.dropna(subset=["departure_time"])
    first_departures = valid_times.groupby("stop_id", sort=False)["departure_time"].min()
    last_departures = valid_times.groupby("stop_id", sort=False)["departure_time"].max()

    out = stops[["stop_id", "stop_name", "stop_lat", "stop_lon"]].copy()
    out["n_departures"] = out["stop_id"].map(departure_counts).fillna(0).astype(int)
    out["n_routes"] = out["stop_id"].map(route_counts).fillna(0).astype(int)
    out["first_departure"] = out["stop_id"].map(first_departures).fillna("")
    out["last_departure"] = out["stop_id"].map(last_departures).fillna("")

    columns = [
        "stop_id",
        "stop_name",
        "stop_lat",
        "stop_lon",
        "n_departures",
        "n_routes",
        "first_departure",
        "last_departure",
    ]
    out = out[columns]

    with open(out_path, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        writer = csv.writer(f, quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL, lineterminator="\n")
        writer.writerow(columns)
        for _, row in out.iterrows():
            writer.writerow(
                [
                    int(row["stop_id"]),
                    row["stop_name"],
                    row["stop_lat"],
                    row["stop_lon"],
                    int(row["n_departures"]),
                    int(row["n_routes"]),
                    row["first_departure"],
                    row["last_departure"],
                ]
            )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
</solution_file>

import csv
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd


def main():
    here = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    root = here.parent if here.name == "src" else here

    stops_path = root / "outputs" / "t05_clean_stops.csv"
    stop_times_path = root / "outputs" / "t05_clean_stop_times.csv"
    gtfs_zip_path = root / "inputs" / "gtfs" / "sample_city_gtfs.zip"
    out_path = root / "outputs" / "t06_stop_service_intensity.csv"

    out_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    stops = pd.read_csv(
        stops_path,
        dtype={
            "stop_id": "int64",
            "stop_name": "string",
            "stop_lat": "string",
            "stop_lon": "string",
        },
        keep_default_na=False,
    )

    stop_times = pd.read_csv(
        stop_times_path,
        dtype={
            "trip_id": "int64",
            "arrival_time": "string",
            "departure_time": "string",
            "stop_id": "int64",
            "stop_sequence": "int64",
        },
    )

    with zipfile.ZipFile(gtfs_zip_path) as zf:
        with zf.open("trips.txt") as f:
            trips = pd.read_csv(
                f,
                dtype={
                    "route_id": "int64",
                    "trip_id": "int64",
                },
            )

    departure_counts = stop_times.groupby("stop_id", sort=False).size()

    stop_routes = stop_times[["trip_id", "stop_id"]].merge(
        trips[["trip_id", "route_id"]],
        on="trip_id",
        how="left",
    )
    stop_routes = stop_routes.dropna(subset=["route_id"])
    route_counts = stop_routes.groupby("stop_id", sort=False)["route_id"].nunique()

    valid_times = stop_times.dropna(subset=["departure_time"])
    first_departures = valid_times.groupby("stop_id", sort=False)["departure_time"].min()
    last_departures = valid_times.groupby("stop_id", sort=False)["departure_time"].max()

    out = stops[["stop_id", "stop_name", "stop_lat", "stop_lon"]].copy()
    out["n_departures"] = out["stop_id"].map(departure_counts).fillna(0).astype(int)
    out["n_routes"] = out["stop_id"].map(route_counts).fillna(0).astype(int)
    out["first_departure"] = out["stop_id"].map(first_departures).fillna("")
    out["last_departure"] = out["stop_id"].map(last_departures).fillna("")

    columns = [
        "stop_id",
        "stop_name",
        "stop_lat",
        "stop_lon",
        "n_departures",
        "n_routes",
        "first_departure",
        "last_departure",
    ]
    out = out[columns]

    with open(out_path, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        writer = csv.writer(f, quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL, lineterminator="\n")
        writer.writerow(columns)
        for _, row in out.iterrows():
            writer.writerow(
                [
                    int(row["stop_id"]),
                    row["stop_name"],
                    row["stop_lat"],
                    row["stop_lon"],
                    int(row["n_departures"]),
                    int(row["n_routes"]),
                    row["first_departure"],
                    row["last_departure"],
                ]
            )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
